metadata.case_name: YU LAM v. MA CHAK YIN T/A WAI KEI ENGINEERING CO AND ANOTHER

plaintiff.expected_occupation_after: light work such as a caretaker, watchman or filling station attendant

injuries.description: fracture of the left lumbar transverse process
source: He suffered a fracture of the left lumbar transverse process and the right tibia, fibula and medial malleolus.

injuries.description: fracture of the right tibia, fibula and medial malleolus
injuries.body_part: right tibia, right fibula and right medial malleolus
source: He suffered a fracture of the left lumbar transverse process and the right tibia, fibula and medial malleolus.

injuries.description: old fractures of the right tibia and fibula with the plate and screws used as fixation devices still in situ (pre-existing)
source: X-rays showed new fractures of the right tibia and fibula and old fractures of the same bones at a more distal location with the plate and screws that were used as fixation devices for that injury still in situ.

injuries.description: advanced degenerative changes in the lumbar spine
source: X-rays showed advanced degenerative changes in the lumbar spine but an anatomic union of the fracture of the L3.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the abdomen, lower back, lumbar spine or pelvis

manifestations.description: continuing pain and swelling in the right leg
slight valgus deformity of the ankle joint
inability to do heavy manual work; cannot return to pre-accident occupation as a construction site worker
cannot endure periods of standing, heavy lifting, carrying and squatting

treatments_received: operation for removal of locking screws of the right tibia fracture (6 September 2002)
treatments_future: removal of metal implants / future surgery

losses.description: Unable to work as a construction site worker any more; only fit for light work such as a caretaker, watchman or filling station attendant
Cannot endure periods of standing, heavy lifting, carrying and squatting
